# FDG4058

> DO apply `AssemblyVersionAttribute` to assemblies with public types.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.10 Types and Assembly Metadata.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1016
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application none, test none
- Status: verified

Library only: the text scopes it to assemblies with public types. CA1016 reports an assembly without AssemblyVersionAttribute; SDK-style projects generate the attribute, so it reports only when GenerateAssemblyInfo is off. CA1016 has no code fix.

## From the book

```csharp
[assembly:AssemblyVersion(...)]
```
